items.name: Whispered Courage Whiskey
items.description: "Drink the blood of heroes."Whispered Courage is aged in barrels made from pines cut from the Stoneheart Massacre Glade.This powerful spirit grants +4 vs fear saves for 1 hour. The bonus is doubled if an ally who also drank the whiskey is threatened within your sight.

items.name: Sextant
items.description:
Price 500 gp; Weight 2 lbs.
Category Adventuring Gear
DescriptionA sextant is used to determine your latitude. Using a sextant with an astrolabe gives you a +4 circumstance bonus on Survival checks made to prevent getting lost.

items.name: Dragonhide
items.description: From a dragon, enough leather can be harvested to create a decent Half Plate Armor out of it. Depending on the hide used, it will also come with resistance to damage of propriety of the dragon that was slain dragon(Blue, Lightning/ White, Cold/ Red, Fire). Due to the armor not being made of metal, the druid class will be able to wear it without any penalties.

items.name: Corn
items.description: Corn is one of the most farmed grains, as it can be turned into oil and flour. Corn itself is a staple food throughout the realms for all consumers and their livestock. The plant in itself is called Maize and it is usually planted as the warmer seasons begin because it is not resistant to the cold.

items.description: This dish features a cooked piece of game brought in by adventurers. The meats are usually not found on most tavern menus and are for the bravest patrons who are not afraid to experiment.

items.description: It is sometimes also named Sparrow Grass, its young shoots are often used as a spring vegetable. They are usually served as an appetizer or a vegetable side dish. In some regions, there is word of a festival held in its honor.

items.name: Torch
items.description:
Price 1 cp; Weight 1 lb.

A torch burns for 1 hour, shedding normal light in a 20-foot radius and increasing the light level by one step for an additional 20 feet beyond that area (darkness becomes dim light and dim light becomes normal light). A torch does not increase the light level in normal light or bright light. If a torch is used in combat, treat it as a one-handed improvised weapon that deals bludgeoning damage equal to that of a gauntlet of its size, plus 1 point of fire damage.

items.description: This specific iron, found in the most secluded deep mines quite cold to the touch, it is known that for those who venture into the Fey realm, it is a must. Most sylvan creatures damaged or attempting to attack a creature wearing Cold Iron armors seem to be taking an additional 1d4 cold damage.

items.description:
A small tent holds one Medium creature and takes 20 minutes to assemble.
Two Small creatures count as a Medium creature. Packing up a tent takes half as long as assembling it.

items.name: Gloomgrape
items.description:
Experience the highs and lows that can only come from a wine aged in barrels made from trees splattered with the blood of demonic soldiers infected with an eternal curse. 
Gloomgrape, you'll be sad you did!

items.name: Potion of Blur
items.description:
The subject's outline appears blurred, shifting, and wavering. This distortion grants the subject concealment (20% miss chance).
A see invisibility spell does not counteract the blur effect, but a true seeing spell does.
Opponents that cannot see the subject ignore the spell's effect (though fighting an unseen opponent carries penalties of its own).

items.name: Dorcroast
items.description: Dorcroast, the invigorating cold brew coffee inspired by the triumph over darkness in Ustalav, awakens your senses with a bittersweet symphony. With a delightful spritz of energy, Dorcroast revitalizes your day, infusing it with the indomitable spirit that arises from the genocide of one's enemies. items.name: La Calstroix Bottle
items.description: A bottle of sparkling water from La Calstroix river in Shudderwood.

items.name: Broadcloth
items.description: The most common type of cloth, it is usually referred to as plain cloth. Traditionally used in any form of clothing, as well, as for interior decoration, such as tablecloths, curtains, and wall covers.

items.name: Chocolate Chip Cookie
items.description: The chocolate chip cookie is a sweet baked treat that is recognized by its buttery flavor and the inclusion of chocolate chips, which can be dark, milk, or white chocolate depending on personal preference. It's a classic favorite for people of all ages, not just young folk, and is often enjoyed with a cold glass of milk or a warm cup of coffee.
